title: OPD call 46 ultrarychlé dobíjecí stanice — 315 million CZK for 150 kW+ car fast chargers anywhere in Czechia
money_note: published call allocation 315,000,000 CZK (Cohesion Fund, max. 55 % of eligible costs; applicant co-funds min. 45 %) converted at 24.465 CZK/EUR, the ČNB daily rate of 2 October 2026 (list #190, still the latest fixing when read on 5 October before the 14:30 fixing); no EUR figure is published for the call
summary: The Transport Ministry declared a 315 million CZK call for ultra-fast public charging stations of at least 150 kW for passenger cars anywhere in Czechia, with a minimum of 10 stations per project. Applications run 14 October 2026 to 6 January 2027.
notes: MS2021+ open-data diff, run 2026-10-05 against the XML snapshot DATE=2026-10-04T20:45 (sha256 b8638ab3…a76a2e); code-level left side = the 819-code list in the 2026-09-28 manifest (hash-verified, identical today, +0/-0), field-level left side = the 2026-09-19 XML with the 09-21 and 09-28 documented deltas subtracted. 04_26_046 moved Finalizovaná -> Otevřená this week (zpřístupnění 2026-10-01 in the XML). Call text 'verze ze dne 30. 9. 2026': declared 30. 9. 2026, application accessible in the monitoring system 7. 10. 2026, receipt 14. 10. 2026 to 6. 1. 2027 14:00, physical completion by 31. 12. 2029. Eligible: owners of the public-access infrastructure, any business or legal person with a Czech IČ, max. 2 applications per IČ. Cost cap 1,900,000 CZK per 150 kW station plus 10,000 CZK per extra kW. GBER block-exemption regime. Programme 04 = Program Doprava 2021-2027, measure 09 sub-programme 1a2; sibling of ledger records dotace-opd-44-rychlodobijeci-prioritni and dotace-opd-45-bezne-dobijeci-mesta. Receipts: pages/opd-46-text-vyzvy.pdf (from opd.cz/UploadFiles/vyzva_46_AP_1a2_RS-osobni-cela CR_2026-09-30.pdf), pages/opd-vyzva-46.html (news box: 'ŘO OPD3 vyhlásil ve středu 30. září výzvu č. 46').
quote: Minimální rozsah projektu: 10 DC ultrarychlých dobíjecích stanic s minimálním výkonem 150 kW.

money_note: published call allocation 62,000,000 CZK (EU share 46,500,000 CZK = 75 %, national 15,500,000 CZK = 25 %) converted at 24.465 CZK/EUR, the ČNB daily rate of 2 October 2026 (list #190, still the latest fixing when read on 5 October before the 14:30 fixing); no EUR figure is published for the call
summary: The Interior Ministry opened 62 million CZK from the Internal Security Fund to implement EU Directive 2024/1260 on asset recovery and confiscation, funding analytical and AI tools, IT infrastructure and training for the Asset Recovery Office, and storage and management capacity for seized property. title: OP ST call 117 Zavádění nástrojů AI do výuky — 58.8 million CZK for AI and VR teaching in Karlovarský kraj secondary schools
money_note: published call allocation 58,823,529.41 CZK total (EU share 50,000,000 CZK, own sources 8,823,529.41 CZK; max. 85 % support) converted at 24.465 CZK/EUR, the ČNB daily rate of 2 October 2026 (list #190, still the latest fixing when read on 5 October before the 14:30 fixing); no EUR figure is published for the call
summary: The Environment Ministry's Just Transition programme declared a call for Karlovarský kraj to bring AI and virtual-reality tools into secondary-school teaching, with teacher training, methodological support and school-administration efficiency also eligible.
